title: Top Student — Tiny Bibby, valedictorian of Savoy High School
text:
Top Student
Tiny Bibby, 17, has been named valedictorian of the Savoy High School senior class with a four-year average of 96.28. She is the daughter of Mr. and Mrs. B. P. Bibby. Runnerup in scholastic average is Helen Horn, the salutatorian and daughter of Mr. and Mrs. Lee Horn. Third high was Tommy Smith with 91.9. She is the daughter of Mrs. Emma Smith of Savoy.
notes: Portrait photo of Tiny Bibby, young woman with wavy hair. Caption 'Top Student' above article text.
